messages:
morgan: Quick sync — I'm putting together a longview doc for routing economics + onramp criteria for multi-region + tenant isolation. Draft attached in GH but want short thread to capture immediate tradeoffs before the working session.
anya: thanks. high-level ask: we need a clear launch checklist that product/sales can use when customers request region isolation. not just tech readiness but contract/pricing triggers.
kevin: +1. from infra side we need deterministic fallback rules so we can commit to an SLA. recommendation: policy matrix with ordered fallbacks (region -> model-variant -> deprioritize non-critical requests).
liam: ops note: console must show per-tenant cost delta for slicing before GA. if customers see a >20% uplift we should have a documented discount path.
sanjay: model-aware routing needs to be in scope: some models balloon cost with long sequences — routing should accept a simple profile: avg seq, 95p seq, preferred quantization. default fallback should be a quantized variant with quality guardrails.
morgan: rough timeline idea: Q3 pilot with 3 customers (one PLG, one mid-market, one enterprise), Q4 expand pilots, GA in Q1. pilot acceptance = infra + product + sales signoff.
anya: acceptance checklist (first pass):
```
- regional latency SLOs defined per-customer (p50/p95/p99)
- cost uplift estimate published + per-tenant projection tool in console
- routing policy templates (strict isolation, best-effort isolation, affinity)
- rollout plan: canary -> 2 customers -> 10 customers -> GA
- rollback criteria and automated evacuation runbook
- legal/compliance: data residency statement, egress controls
```
kevin: adding technical knobs:
```
routing_policy: {
  precedence: ["region", "model_variant", "capacity_tier"],
  fallback_timeout_ms: 250,
  cost_threshold_pct: 15
}
quality_guard: {
  max_deviation_pct: 3,
  prompt_set: "onramp-regression-suite-v1"
}
```
liam: ops + SRE must own the evacuation automation and prove a dry-run with <5s request failure rate during simulated cutover. include a test plan.
sanjay: perf signals we need in telemetry: token-level cost, kv-cache-hit, sequence-length distro, model-variant chosen. these feed Optimize heuristics.
morgan: commercial asks: sales needs a templated pricing uplift matrix and a checklist for reserved capacity offers. we'll draft with finance after initial pilot numbers.
kevin: prioritization note — tradeoffs: tighter isolation -> more infra units and slower scheduling -> higher cost. we should surface an "isolation tax" in the console and in PRICING docs.
anya: next steps: 1) align arch on policy matrix today, 2) ops to sketch migration runbook by Wed, 3) product to draft sales-facing onramp doc by Fri.
deploy-bot: meeting created: "Routing Economics & Onramp — working session" Thu 10:00 • https://meet.redwood/in/route-econ (added morgan, anya, kevin, liam, sanjay) :calendar:"
